text:
Anna: Quick heads-up — LumenEdge reported their PO is stuck after hitting a new intermediate auth step in the cloud marketplace portal. They can't provision VMs. @Mike can you look? :thinking:

Mike: yep. Portal responding with `INTERMEDIATE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` which our ingestion treats as an error. I'll flip the handler to accept it as pending, but need to pause the auto-fail job first.

Raj: pausing auto-fail now — `POST /internal/pause?job=po-auto-fail` — done.

Lisa: Sales Ops — I'll ask LumenEdge to re-upload the signed PO and include the signer email. Want to confirm Finance can do manual invoice + entitlement while this is mitigated.

Sam: Legal OK for a one-off allowed provisioning if Finance approves and we attach the PO PDF plus a short approval note. No contract edits needed.

Mike: created temporary entitlement: `POST /entitlements {customer:LumenEdge,sku:dedicated-1}` — entitlement id EN-202406. Linked to the uploaded PO.

ops-bot: Job po-auto-fail: paused by Raj at 2024-06-07T16:45:12Z

Raj: processed a manual invoice draft and sent to Finance. @Sam please review the approval note format so we attach it to the PO record.

Sam: draft ready: "Approved provision pending portal fix. Finance approval on file. Signed by: <name>, email: <email>". Attach and stamp with timestamp.

Mike: I'll push a fix to treat `INTERMEDIATE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` as `PENDING` in the webhook mapping; testing in staging now. If green I'll roll this evening. ETA ~2.5h.

Anna: thanks. I'll call LumenEdge and confirm they have the temporary entitlement and next steps. I'll open a ticket with the marketplace PMs requesting they add the new status to our integration spec. Keep this thread live for updates. :thumbsup:
